key_insight: For the scheduling instance and initialization studied, an entanglement-free VQA found feasible schedules without the simulation overhead of entangled alternatives.
engineering_relevance: The approach addresses workforce scheduling with skill, capacity, priority, deadline, and rescheduling-stability considerations while limiting each daily batch to at most 30 qubits.
method: Formulate multi-skill project scheduling as a QUBO.
Decompose scheduling into daily batches, propagate remaining workload, and use logarithmic binary encoding.
Compare linear and brick-wall entangling ansätze against a parameter-matched entanglement-free reference using COBYLA and Adam with SPSA gradients.
evidence_signal: In simulations, the entanglement-free reference produced feasible schedules with both optimizers; with COBYLA, it came closest to the required workload at a fraction of the entangled topologies' simulation cost.
watch_item: Results are limited to the studied instance and initialization; broader scalability and performance on noisy quantum hardware remain unestablished.
paper_title: A Variational Quantum Algorithm for Multi-Skill Project Scheduling
